title: CMMC Series 20: The Pentagon Riverscape
summary: An agent-managed DAO cell beside the Potomac at the Pentagon: five walkable zones for synthesis, proposals and operations, with agents at work and humans holding every final decision.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: Outcomes Gallery
buildings.use: Public reading room for the DAO mission

props: banner of the six reserved human actions

buildings.name: Proposal Hall
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and decided by people

court.name: The Central Courtyard Round
court.style: Neoclassical rings around a five-sided court
court.why_here: The Pentagon's real Central Courtyard gives the DAO a literal center for debate; every path radiates outward to the zones, just as every proposal radiates to human voters.

quests.title: Set the Focus
steps: Read the charter's mission plaque in Charter Hall
Ask Research Synthesis Agent what focus options exist
Record the gap where no focus is set
Deliver the gap note to the Progress Tracker

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect three summaries from Evidence Monitor
Have Research Synthesis Agent merge them
Watch Proposal & Grant Drafter write a draft
Confirm the draft is marked 'human decision required'

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Take the drafted proposal from the Forum
Deliver it to Task Router
Follow Collaborator Scout's roster of experts
Join a working group dock before the next cycle

quests.title: Measure What Matters
steps: Collect outcome data from the working groups
Bring it to Progress Tracker at the Observatory
Compare against the Outcomes Wall in Charter Hall
Flag any unmet measurable outcome

quests.title: The Sealed Vote
steps: Review progress metrics at the Observatory
Walk the proposal to Proposal Forum's human Vote Chamber
Observe that no agent may cast the final vote
Return the enacted decision to Charter Hall's ledger
